chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi, from his father, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Jarrah al-Madaini, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That he disliked wearing a shirt hemmed with brocade, and he disliked wearing silk, and wearing embroidered clothes, and he disliked the red saddlecloth, for it is the saddlecloth of Iblis.
ai.seo_question: What clothing items did Imam al-Sadiq (as) dislike and why?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) discouraged wearing shirts with brocade hems, silk, embroidered garments, and red saddlecloths, identifying the latter as the attire of Iblis. This narration highlights the Shia emphasis on distinguishing between permissible luxury and ostentatious display (takhalluq bi-khalq Allah), linking specific colors and fabrics to spiritual humility and the rejection of pride associated with the devil.
